scope: Local SQLite workflow under trusted fictional actor contexts; no real authentication or external publication.

required_cases.F01: Allowed editor rename persists a new revision and event
required_cases.F02: Reader cannot mutate and rejection leaves persisted state unchanged
required_cases.F03: Cross-scope reads and mutations are denied without state changes
required_cases.F04: Publication without current fictional approval is denied
required_cases.F05: Fictional reviewer approval permits editor local publication
required_cases.F06: Editor cannot grant its own reviewer approval
required_cases.F07: Editing invalidates approval for an earlier revision
required_cases.F08: Invalid title leaves no partial write or event
required_cases.F09: Failure after writes rolls back state and event; recovery succeeds
required_cases.F10: A fresh process reads persisted publication and revision
required_cases.F11: Unknown role and empty actor are rejected without changes
required_cases.F13: An unknown action is rejected without changes
required_cases.F14: Published records cannot be renamed by this draft-only fixture
required_cases.F15: Changes in one scope preserve unrelated scope records

closure: All required cases observed PASS, fixture/source identity retained, failures and limits recorded. No global pilot promotion.
